links.comparator_used: output-only safety check on the agent's final output
links.outcome: share of faulty agent trajectories stopped at the fault step (emergency department, MIMIC-IV-ED)
links.effect: Gateway stopped 62% of faulty trajectories at the fault step vs 31% for an output-only check; false intervention on 7.0% of clean trajectories
links.tradeoff: False intervention on 7.0% of clean trajectories. On held-out ICU hospitals the drift signal deferred every request. p99 latency was 25.8 ms per gated action on a Raspberry Pi 5, almost all from the nearest-neighbour signal, which added no measurable detection in the emergency setting.
